confirm.title: {entity_id} was not carried over to {new_device}
confirm.description:
When {old_device} was replaced with {new_device}, {entity_id} had no counterpart on the new device, but it is still used in: {used_in}.

Change or remove those references, then confirm.

device_automation_unsupported.title: {automation} uses a device {section} {new_device} does not offer

confirm.title: {automation} uses a device {section} {new_device} does not offer
confirm.description:
{automation} uses the device {section} "{type}" of {old_device}. Its device ID now points at {new_device}, which does not offer it, so it will not work.

Edit the automation to use something {new_device} offers, then confirm.

confirm.title: {kind} {name} still refers to {old_device}
confirm.description: The {kind} {name} refers to the replaced device {old_device} in configuration that Home Assistant does not manage (YAML), so it was not updated. Replace the old device ID with the one of {new_device}, then confirm.
